text:
incident-bot: ALERT: P2 - embeddings/reranker pipeline error rate spike. Routing: batch-embed endpoint returning 500s. Auto-page to oncall team. 

arya (oncall): seeing the page. investigating now — what's the customer impact? any SLO alerts? :eyes:

julie (support): multiple enterprise customers reported reranker failures starting ~10:12 UTC. tickets 5421, 5422, 5427 — users see errors on batch uploads. intermittent for single requests.

maria (sre): Grafana shows error rate for /v1/embeddings/batch jumped from ~0.5% to ~38% at 10:11 UTC. Latency also increased for retries. No infra scaling events at that time.

arya (oncall): ok can someone share a representative stack/log snippet? prioritize customer-facing errors and any obvious stack traces.

samir (ml-eng): pasting snippet from the reranker service logs (kibana link: https://kibana.redwood/internal/app/kibana#/discover/doc/abc123). main error repeated: 

```
ERROR RuntimeError: vector length mismatch: expected 1536, got 1535
  at Reranker.encode (/srv/reranker/encoder.py:212)
  at BatchHandler.process (/srv/reranker/handler.py:78)
  at Runner.run_request (/srv/runtime/runner.go:456)
  ...
```

samir (ml-eng): looks like a single sample in the batch is returning a shorter vector from the embedder. we see `len(vec) != expected_dim` validation failing and raising an exception that bubbles up.

maria (sre): digging S3 logs for batch payloads: s3://redwood-logs/reranker/2026-01-15/10/11/<file>.ndjson — found one payload where one item is missing text (empty string) and the embedding service returned a shorter vector.

julie (support): customer-reported payloads contain mixed documents, some with HTML stripped. They said one file had a blank line at the end from their export tool.

arya (oncall): timeline so far (rough):
- 10:11:12 UTC: first errors spike on prod (alert)
- 10:12:05 UTC: support ticket 5421 opened (customer A)
- 10:13:40 UTC: reranker service starts returning 500s to clients
- 10:15:00 UTC: attempts to retry batch requests increased 3x
- 10:20:00 UTC: initial mitigation (auto-retry) observed but failed due to immediate validation error

samir (ml-eng): adding hypothesis list. will mark as H1/H2 etc so we can triage in-thread.
H1: Upstream embedder produced incorrect vector length for an empty or malformed document (most likely).
H2: Recent embedder model rollback/variant changed output dim (e.g., quant/config mismatch).
H3: Batch-aggregation code applied a clip/trim bug for last element (off-by-one).
H4: Serialization/deserialization bug when storing vectors in cache causing truncation.

maria (sre): quick checks: no recent deploys flagged for embedder in last 24h per deploy-bot. devops-bot: 

devops-bot: ACTIVE_DEPLOYS: embedder-service: last_deploy=2026-01-14T03:02:21Z, reranker: last_deploy=2026-01-10T22:45:00Z

arya (oncall): good. so H2 is lower priority. samir, can you confirm what expected dim is and where the validation happens?

samir (ml-eng): expected_dim = 1536 (model: open-embedding-1536-redwood). validation in encoder.py: `if len(vec) != expected_dim: raise RuntimeError(...)` — we should probably change to log and mark item failed rather than blow up entire batch.

maria (sre): mitigation options for live traffic:
- A) patch reranker to skip offending vectors and return partial results (fast, low-risk code change, possible correctness impact)
- B) fallback to single-record synchronous embed endpoint for batches (slower but isolates failure)
- C) route batch traffic through dedicated legacy embedder variant (if available)
- D) temporary reject batch endpoints with clear 4xx to clients to avoid retries/backpressure

arya (oncall): recommend B for immediate live mitigation: switch batch routing to sequential single-embed calls for incoming batches for next 30m. That will increase latency but keep clients alive. Who can change routing quickly?

maria (sre): I can update routing policy in the gateway to passthrough batch->single for all customers flagged as affected. Will do a canary for 5% first.

kevin (oncall-next): I'm taking next shift at 10:45 UTC. will monitor canary and be ready to roll back changes.

samir (ml-eng): meanwhile I'm pulling the exact vector that failed to inspect. command to fetch from S3: 

```bash
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-logs/reranker/2026-01-15/10/11/<file>.ndjson - | jq '.items[123]'
```

samir (ml-eng): result: JSON item shows `text: ""` (empty). embedder responded with `[0.1,0.2,...]` but length 1535 (last value missing). possible serialization truncation in embedder response pipeline.

arya (oncall): can we reproduce locally by sending a minimal batch with an empty string? someone try curl to the embedder.

samir (ml-eng): yes repro: 

```bash
curl -X POST https://embedder.redwood/v1/embed/batch -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"inputs": ["normal text","", "another text"]}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
# response: 200 with vectors, second vector length=1535
```

samir (ml-eng): attaching full stack logs and a small repro harness in gist: https://gist.redwood/abc-vec-truncation (private)

maria (sre): mitigation update: gateway canary at 5% switched, errors on canary dropped to ~2% from 38% within 6 minutes. increasing to 25% now.

julie (support): informing affected customers about temporary degradation: note that some batch uploads may be slower, but results should come through. drafting message for customer A.

arya (oncall): engineering decision: prioritize patch in embedder to tolerate empty inputs and return a zero-vector (or explicit error per item) instead of truncating. short-term: keep routing change enabling single-record fallback until embedder patch is deployed and validated.

samir (ml-eng): agreed. I'll open PR to encoder to handle empty text -> zero vector of expected_dim and log item id. PR link: https://git.redwood/eng/embedder/merge_requests/789

samir (ml-eng): tests: added unit to ensure output len == expected_dim even when input blank. running CI now.

maria (sre): please also add metric to monitor `embedder.vector_len_mismatch` so we can alert before retries cascade.

eng-ml: noted — will add metric + dashboard.

arya (oncall): handoff: I'm going offline at 10:35 UTC for quick break; kevin you'll carry the incident through to resolution. Kevin, owners: samir for fix, maria for mitigation/routing, julie for customer comms.

kevin (oncall-next): taking it. monitoring CI and canary results. next update in 15m or sooner if anything changes.

maria (sre): postmortem checklist items created: capture timeline, root cause (embedder response truncation on empty input), mitigation steps, follow-ups (input validation at API edge, metric/alert, patch backfill). ticket created: PM-1345.

julie (support): sent updates to customers with incident reference INC-2026-1345, they acknowledged.

samir (ml-eng): PR merged at 10:58 UTC, deploying embedder patch now. patch ensures zero-vector for empty input and logs item id; also added defensive check to avoid raising on per-item mismatch.

devops-bot: DEPLOY embedder-service v2.3.1 started at 10:59:02 UTC -> success at 11:02:17 UTC

maria (sre): canary rollback disabled, monitoring shows error rate steady at ~0.3%. closing mitigation: reverting routing to normal batch path in 5m.

kevin (oncall-next): verified errors returned to baseline. will keep watch for 1 hour. assigning owners for RCA: samir (root cause analysis & code diff), maria (alerting + runbook), julie (customer timeline).

arya (oncall): thanks team — good live mitigation. we'll record this thread in the postmortem. any remaining open actions?

samir (ml-eng): open: add unit test for empty input, add metric for mismatch, update docs for embedder contract, run a retro with eng-ml to discuss batch validation behavior.

maria (sre): open: add paging runbook entry to handle batch endpoint spikes and a checklist to evaluate client-side retries.

julie (support): open: follow up with customers to confirm full resolution and close tickets.

eng-ml: will schedule follow-up meeting and include prevention items.

kevin (oncall-next): taking final note: last_message_ts=1769015400 — will update when fully closed.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATED: INC-2026-1345 status=mitigated severity=P2 assigned_to=kevin
